Placemaker.Recipe.OrchardPark.Descriptio: An orchard open as a park: fruit trees in rows with mown aisles, blossom meadow, picnics under the trees, beehives and a cider stand.
Placemaker.OrchardPark.Name: Orchard park
Placemaker.OrchardPark.style.Tooltip: Which fruit the orchard grows. Presets set the layout to match; automatic trees prefer that fruit when it is installed.
Placemaker.OrchardPark.grid.Tooltip: Square grid, quincunx (every other row offset, like dice fives), tight rows with wide alleys, or blocks of one variety each.
Placemaker.OrchardPark.spacing.Tooltip: Distance between the trees (rows: trees closer in the row, alleys wider).
Placemaker.OrchardPark.rowAngle.Tooltip: Rows along the area's long side, across it, or diagonally.
Placemaker.OrchardPark.paths.Tooltip: A cross through the middle, a grid of blocks, a loop inside the edge, or a blossom avenue lined with trees.
Placemaker.OrchardPark.blockSize.Tooltip: Distance between the grid paths, and the size of the variety blocks.
Placemaker.OrchardPark.gaps.Tooltip: Share of planting spots left empty, as in a real old orchard.
Placemaker.OrchardPark.windbreak.Tooltip: A row of tall trees along the edge sheltering the orchard.
Placemaker.OrchardPark.meadow.Tooltip: Share of the orchard floor left as long meadow (painted patches with wildflowers).
Placemaker.OrchardPark.flowers.Tooltip: Flower clumps per hectare, mostly in the meadow patches.
Placemaker.OrchardPark.mownAisles.Toolti: Mown strips painted between the tree rows. Permanent terrain texture.
Placemaker.OrchardPark.lawn.Tooltip: Covers the whole orchard with a mown grass surface (cherry blossom lawns).
Placemaker.OrchardPark.meadowLayer.Toolt: Terrain layer (1–4) for the meadow patches. Which texture each is depends on the map.
Placemaker.OrchardPark.aisleLayer.Toolti: Terrain layer (1–4) for the mown aisles.
Placemaker.OrchardPark.picnicSpots.Toolt: Picnic tables in the shade between the trees, beside the paths.
Placemaker.OrchardPark.benchEvery.Toolti: A bench along the paths every this many metres (0 = none).
Placemaker.OrchardPark.harvestProps.Tool: Fruit crates and ladders under a few trees.
Placemaker.OrchardPark.glade.Tooltip: An open lawn in the middle with a veteran tree and benches round it; features like a fountain go there.
Placemaker.OrchardPark.Issue.NoGlade: Orchard park: no room for the central glade.
Placemaker.OrchardPark.Issue.NoTrees: Orchard park: no room for fruit trees. Make the spacing smaller or the area bigger.
